text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Day-ahead (D+1) forecasts chained from each 09:00 UTC origin over the week starting 14 July 2025, fixed in advance as the second Monday of the month. Black: observed. Orange: KEZ median, with 80% and 90% bands. Dashed blue: GK median.'
